title: Implement preview and evidence capture
businessObjective: Advance Phase 5 — Independent verification through one bounded preview-verification outcome.
technicalObjective: Implement preview and durable audit evidence capture that attributes provider, model, sanitized prompt or classified prompt artifact reference, prompt/playbook integrity reference, task, requested capabilities, provider states, commands, changed artifacts, verification, and outcome.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence correlates task, provider, model, provider state, sanitized prompt or classified prompt artifact reference, prompt/playbook version or integrity reference, requested capabilities, commands, changed artifacts, policy and approval results, independent verification, and outcome.
Authentication material, secrets, raw sensitive prompts, and unapproved guest data are excluded from ordinary repository evidence.
Preview or evidence failure blocks eligibility and preserves a deterministic reason without enabling production action.
Retention and cleanup preserve the append-only audit boundary and failed-attempt history.
Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the preview-verification branch and generated artifacts; preserve audit and verification evidence.

stateTransitions.reason: Generated from canonical phased implementation backlog.
